name: CHAOS-3505 tripwire proof: every mirrored quirk fails in BOTH directions
$limitation: This plan does not test the port. It tests the TRIPWIRES that pin the deliberately-mirrored quirks, and it exists because the differential oracles cannot do that job alone: an oracle compares Go against Python, so it goes GREEN if both sides are 'fixed' together and a mirrored quirk would then disappear with nothing failing. Mutations T1-T4 fix the quirk in the GO ENGINE (the tripwire must fail); T5-T6 change the REAL CONFIG the pin depends on (the tripwire must also fail, rather than passing vacuously about a section that no longer exists). A tripwire that survives either direction is not a pin.

mutations.rationale: CHAOS-3505 fixed in the engine. The linear tripwire must fail, because that fix changes Linear classification on three axes and must not land silently inside a bug-for-bug port.
Quirk 8 fixed by giving the two orphaned types a priority. The completeness tripwire must fail: the label arm stops falling through, which changes answers wherever such a label is the only match.

The engine stops reproducing str(dict) for the mis-parsed mapping. The misparse tripwire must fail, not just the oracle -- otherwise the only thing protecting that key is a comparison that a coordinated 'fix' on both sides would silence. The Go half of the CHAOS-3512 pin.

mutations.find:
typeIndex, err := buildCategoryIndex(
			providerConfig, provider, "types", validWorkItemTypes)
mutations.replace:
typeIndex, err := buildCategoryIndex(
			providerConfig, provider, "type_labels", validWorkItemTypes)
mutations.rationale: Reading the wrong section makes github/gitlab's type_by_provider non-empty, reviving the dead type_raw arm. The structural-deadness tripwire must fail.

THE CONFIG DIRECTION. Correcting the one-space typo makes the entry a plain string, so GitHub items labelled type:bug start classifying as bug instead of issue. The tripwire must fail rather than quietly keep passing about a mapping that is no longer there -- this is the direction an oracle can never see, because both engines would agree on the new value. This IS the CHAOS-3512 fix, applied to the config; the tripwire must fail so the Go re-mirror is forced in the same change.

THE CONFIG DIRECTION for CHAOS-3505. If the ignored section is renamed or deleted, the linear pin describes nothing; a tripwire that still passed would be reporting coverage it no longer has. Both engines would agree here too, so again the oracle cannot catch it.
